text: A weightlifter performs an exercise in which he raises a mass of 200 kg from rest vertically through
a distance of 0.7 m and holds it at that height.
A particle of mass 0.5 kg starts from rest and slides down a line of greatest slope of a smooth plane.
The plane is inclined at an angle of 30Å to the horizontal.

developed by the lorry’s engine is constant, and there is a constant resistance to motion of 3200 N.

A cyclist starts from rest at point A and moves in a straight line with acceleration 0.5 m s for a
distance of 36 m. The cyclist then travels at constant speed for 25 s before slowing down, with
constant deceleration, to come to rest at point B. The distance AB is 210 m.
